title: Plane × FreeFrame Review
architecture: Plane identifies the work item; FreeFrame owns media review.
noProject: Open a Premiere project to continue.
noSequence: Select an active sequence in Premiere to continue.
connectionIntro: Validate a Plane personal access token, then choose the work item for this sequence.
planePatHint: Stored only in UXP secure storage after the binding is confirmed. Leave blank to reuse a saved token for this Plane URL.
noWorkspaces: This account has no available workspaces.
noProjects: This workspace has no available projects.
noWorkItems: This project has no available work items.
disconnectLocalHint: This removes only the local Premiere mapping. It does not unlink the FreeFrame asset from the Plane work item.
localDisconnected: The local sequence mapping was removed. The remote Plane ↔ FreeFrame link was not changed.
missingCredential: No saved Plane token is available for this URL. Enter a token to reconnect.
discoveryError: Plane workspace, project, or work-item discovery failed.
bindingError: The sequence binding could not be saved.
restoreError: The saved sequence binding could not be restored. Validate the Plane connection again.
hostError: Premiere did not provide a stable project or sequence identity.
fileFallback: Use exported-file fallback until the host adapter is completed.
next: Continue implementation from the clients and adapters in src/.
assetUnlinked: This work item is not linked to a FreeFrame asset.
assetManageRequired: The server did not grant review:manage, so this asset link cannot be changed here.
noCompatibleAssets: No compatible unlinked video assets were found.
noVersions: No media versions have been uploaded yet.
unlinkRemoteHint: Plane removes its projection only after FreeFrame confirms the unlink.
confirmRemoteUnlink: Remove the authoritative Plane ↔ FreeFrame link for this work item? Media and review data remain in FreeFrame.
reviewUnavailable: The authoritative review state could not be loaded.
reviewLoadError: The Plane and FreeFrame review state could not be loaded or confirmed.
assetCatalogError: The FreeFrame asset catalog could not be loaded through Plane.
selectAssetRequired: Select a compatible video asset first.
assetLinked: Plane and FreeFrame confirmed the asset link.
assetConflict: This asset is already linked to another work item or the work item has a different asset link.
assetLinkError: The asset link could not be confirmed by both Plane and FreeFrame.
assetNameRequired: Enter a name for the new video asset.
creatingAsset: Creating, linking, and confirming the asset…
assetCreatedLinked: The video asset was created and the Plane ↔ FreeFrame link was confirmed.
assetCreateError: The video asset could not be created and linked safely.
unlinkingAsset: Unlinking and confirming the remote state…
assetUnlinkedConfirmed: FreeFrame and Plane confirmed the remote unlink.
assetUnlinkError: The remote asset link could not be removed and confirmed.
uploadPermissionRequired: The server did not grant review:upload.
noExportPrepared: Choose an explicit .epr preset and output file before direct export.
directExportSmokeHint: Premiere render progress and host-side cancellation require a 25.6 smoke test; local waiting, upload, and processing can be cancelled.
directExportUnavailable: Direct export is unavailable in this Premiere host. Use the exported-file fallback.
mediaSelected: Exported media selected for this panel session. Multipart chunks are read from disk only when uploaded.
mediaSelectionError: The exported media file could not be read safely.
exportPrepared: The export preset and output path are ready for this panel session.
exportPrepareError: The direct export configuration could not be prepared.
transferReadyNotice: FreeFrame reports the uploaded version as ready and playback metadata is available.
transferCancelledNotice: The local transfer was cancelled. A render already accepted by Premiere may continue until host cancellation is smoke-tested.
transferError: The export, upload, or processing operation failed.
noReviewVersions: No review version is available for comments.
commentsLoading: Loading comments for the selected version…
commentsEmpty: This version has no public review comments.
commentPermissionRequired: The server did not grant review:comment. Comments are read-only.
creatingComment: Creating and confirming the frame-accurate comment…
commentCreated: FreeFrame confirmed the comment and canonical frame.
commentCreateError: The review comment could not be created and confirmed.
commentLoadError: Comments for the selected version could not be loaded safely.
commentTimingUnavailable: Canonical timing is unavailable for this version.
commentTimingConflict: The stored frame and legacy time value disagree. No marker should be created.
commentOutsideVersion: This comment position is outside the selected review version.
commentOutsideSequence: This comment position is outside the active Premiere sequence.
resolutionUpdated: FreeFrame confirmed the comment resolution state.
resolutionError: FreeFrame did not confirm the requested resolution state.
reviewPanelNeedsBinding: Bind the active sequence to a Plane work item before loading review comments.
markerSyncHint: Sync creates or updates only Plane × FreeFrame markers for the selected asset version. Editor markers and other review versions are preserved.
markersUnavailable: Premiere marker Actions are unavailable in this host.
markersSyncing: Reconciling timeline markers in one Premiere transaction…
markersSynced: Premiere confirmed the selected-version marker transaction.
markerSyncError: Timeline markers could not be reconciled safely.
